Chapter 6564: And You Can?

Chapter 6564: And You Can?

“Pluff!” Sounds traveled through time and space, spreading in inconceivable channels.

Primal Yin Immortal Ghost crossed through the space affected by his yin affinity. Unfortunately, the dimensions couldn’t stop the spear.

It pierced him in several spots. The yin armor closed again but not the gaping wounds.

“Skyslayer Ghost!” He roared and swung his Skybreaker Decapitator.

“Boom!” Flames ignited everywhere before gathering onto the hatchet.

It cut a path and revealed the primordial. Those in Heaven World were scared out of their mind, prompting Chengtian to assume a defensive pose.

Immortal Killer looked unbreakable, successfully blocking the slash. The ghost’s armament was impressive but couldn’t compare to this spear.

“Pluff!” He was half a beat too slow and the spear just barely missed his throat, piercing his shoulder instead.

He retreated to keep a safe distance, not pleased with the situation. The holes in his armor no longer closed as fast as before while blood seeped out.

His tattered state was a testament to Immortal Killer’s deadly nature. Chengtian didn’t have a speck of dust on him. He was not an immortal yet resembled an immortal more than anyone else.

He lived with immortals all his life and not just any immortal, primordial immortals. The air around him seeped into his body. Even rotten wood could turn into immortal wood in the same condition.

Because of this, his movement was in harmony with the immortal dao. No one else in Three Immortals had the same privilege including Zhan Sansheng and Desolate Ancestor.

His advantages drove people insane with jealousy. Although he wasn’t the most handsome man in history, his aura made everyone feel that he was perfect and likable.

Everyone could imagine how irritated Primal Yin Immortal Ghost was. He was older but had to address Chengtian as “Dao Brother”.

He believed his innate talent and dao heart were as brilliant. Alas, why was his life so difficult in comparison?

As long as Chengtian was around, he couldn’t rid himself of this sense of inferiority. Rage originating from jealousy took over.

Before this, only Orchid Sage overshadowed him, albeit to a lesser extent. Given his gifts and achievements, why was someone else allowed to make him feel like a clown?

His rage extended to both the high heaven and Xian Chengtian. The former was unfair for not rewarding his efforts and sacrifices. On the other hand, the latter enjoyed everything life had to offer.

“I will become an immortal!” His rage erupted.

“You will never because of your heart devil.” Chengtian stared down at him and said.

“And you can?!” He shouted back.

“I cannot.” Chengtian smiled, as otherworldly as ever: “But I have lived my entire life among immortals.”

That simple sentence was like a punch to the gut. It stunned everyone and broke through the ghost’s mental defense.

He had spent his entire life chasing immortality, struggling every step of the way but Chengtian had grown up surrounded by it, immersed in the immortal path from the very beginning.
